decisions.reason: As a close-to-core line with its own dedicated page, it looks like a committed extension whose uncertainty can be resolved further at relatively low cost, so keeping the option open is sensible.

The serum fits the firm's established natural facial-care business and likely uses existing capabilities, so despite more limited website prominence it is still worth retaining while demand becomes clearer.

The cleansing milk is also an adjacent product that can be supported within the current range, and with no clear negative signal yet the firm would likely keep it on the market a bit longer rather than exit immediately.
